summary: 🛣️ **QuanPieces** adds new plank wall, triangular floor, shelf edge and item stand pieces.

bullets: New beam-free wood walls in several sizes, including 3 m tall 2x3 and 1x3 walls.
New triangular wood floors and a bevelled shelf edge for small gaps and neat 1x1 shelf ends.
New item stands (wall and floor) with only the nub, plus invisible versions that hide the nub while holding an item.
